reference_answer:
```lua
go.property("speed", 200)

local LEFT = hash("left")
local RIGHT = hash("right")

function init(self)
    msg.post(".", "acquire_input_focus")
    self.dir = 0
end

function update(self, dt)
    local p = go.get_position()
    p.x = p.x + self.dir * self.speed * dt
    go.set_position(p)
    self.dir = 0
end

function on_input(self, action_id, action)
    if action_id == LEFT then
        self.dir = -1
    elseif action_id == RIGHT then
        self.dir = 1
    end
end
```

goal: Composer scene with proper lifecycle and cleanup
prompt: In Solar2D (2026 build): write a Composer scene file game.lua that creates a background and a score text in create, starts an enterFrame listener when shown, and removes it when hidden.
hard_fail: Uses an API removed or renamed in the current version

forbid.why: Storyboard API was removed; Composer replaced it

reference_answer:
```lua
local composer = require("composer")
local scene = composer.newScene()

local scoreText
local function onFrame(event)
    -- per-frame game logic
end

function scene:create(event)
    local sceneGroup = self.view
    local bg = display.newRect(sceneGroup, display.contentCenterX, display.contentCenterY,
        display.actualContentWidth, display.actualContentHeight)
    bg:setFillColor(0.1, 0.1, 0.2)
    scoreText = display.newText({ parent = sceneGroup, text = "Score: 0", x = 80, y = 30, fontSize = 20 })
end

function scene:show(event)
    if event.phase == "did" then
        Runtime:addEventListener("enterFrame", onFrame)
    end
end

function scene:hide(event)
    if event.phase == "will" then
        Runtime:removeEventListener("enterFrame", onFrame)
    end
end

scene:addEventListener("create", scene)
scene:addEventListener("show", scene)
scene:addEventListener("hide", scene)
return scene
```
